issue.title: In Progress marks and the Alt+[ / Alt+] lane toggle for Pomodoro Task Links
issue.description: In today's daily note, every Task Link under an open Pomodoro whose task is In Progress `[/]` shows a rendered amber half-ring mark (Next shows none), and Alt+[ / Alt+] on any Pomodoro Task Link toggles its task between Next and In Progress, offering an optional Work Log entry when it goes back to Next. Nothing new is ever written into the daily note.
